attribution.limit: From 21 November 2026 (UTC), a website that calls this API from its visitors' browsers and shows the data without visible credit to TipsAudit (neither the words in accepted_text nor a link) can be limited to 100 requests per day, once we have checked the site and found no credit. Our automated daily check reads only the home page and up to five of the site's own scripts; it does not run scripts, open iframes or read other pages. If your credit is somewhere else, write to contact@tipsaudit.com and we will look at the page with the data.
